issue:
Oracle to DuckDB: ADD_MONTHS doesn't return the last day of the month

**Before you file an issue**
- Make sure you specify the "read" dialect eg. `parse_one(sql, read="spark")`: `read="oracle"`
- Make sure you specify the "write" dialect eg. `ast.sql(dialect="duckdb")`: `write="duckdb"`
- Check if the issue still exists on main: checked, the issue is still there on main (a32ef63).

**Fully reproducible code snippet**

```python
import sqlglot

sqlglot.transpile("SELECT ADD_MONTHS(DATE '2024-02-29', 1)", read="oracle", write="duckdb")[0]
# "SELECT CAST(CAST('2024-02-29' AS DATE) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)"
```

Oracle returns `2024-03-31`. The DuckDB output returns `2024-03-29`.

Oracle's `ADD_MONTHS` returns the last day of the resulting month when the input is the last day of its month. Snowflake's `ADD_MONTHS` has the same rule and already transpiles correctly (it's parsed with `preserve_end_of_month=True`), but Oracle's isn't.

**Official Documentation**

https://docs.oracle.com/en/database/oracle/oracle-database/19/sqlrf/ADD_MONTHS.html

Found by myself, but used LLM (Claude) for the Coding portion in the PR (will be posting soon)
